summary: The retry case reaches the same ? stylus menu one step later because its input begins with a space. The first mismatch is again the omitted Miscellaneous heading before the fingertip extra choice in the sortpack menu; all RNG matches, so this is separate menu-layout debt in invent.c:display_pickinv(), not a retry or wand-use branch.

source.branch: In the E command, engrave.c:doengrave() calls getobj("write with", stylus_ok, GETOBJ_PROMPT); stylus_ok(NULL) suggests hands, so getobj() handles ? by passing getobj_hands_txt() as display_pickinv() extra choice. With sortpack active, C invent.c:display_pickinv() inserts a "Miscellaneous" heading before the extra fingertip item. The current JS display_pickinv() usextra branch adds the item without that conditional heading, shifting the whole menu up one row.
callers: C path: engrave.c:doengrave() -> invent.c:getobj() question-mark branch (1963-1981) -> invent.c:display_pickinv(); stylus_ok(NULL) admits hands and the C screen shows the inventory class headings.
JavaScript path: js/engrave.js:doengrave() -> js/invent.js:getobj() question-mark branch (1197-1221) -> js/invent.js:display_pickinv(); its usextra branch currently inserts only the fingertip item.
dependencies: Preserve the flags.sortpack condition and menu item order: C adds the Miscellaneous heading before HANDS_SYM only when the hands/fingertip item is an extra choice, then continues with the existing inventory class headings.

The caller supplies xtra_choice through getobj_hands_txt() because stylus_ok(NULL) returns GETOBJ_SUGGEST; keep that separate from actual inventory objects and use the existing add_menu_heading()/select_menu path.
The missing heading changes screen row placement and the terminal cursor by one line; preserve the existing inventory contents, selectors, selection behavior, and RNG order.
